static_traits.name: Guo Lei
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends are tense due to self-doubt and low mood; rarely discussing inner troubles with others
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; without prior psychotherapy or psychiatric treatment history
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude, clear expression, able to describe problems and trigger situations concretely, fairly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: I signed up for the TV show <The Voice>, but I constantly doubt my abilities, feeling I am never good enough and will not be selected.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to get rid of these self-doubting feelings, enjoy life again, and no longer constantly worry about whether I am good enough.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being selected

special_situations.event: When watching the show 'The Voice', compares with other contestants' performances
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my level is not as good as other contestants, it means I am not good enough and will not be selected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles practice and seeks feedback from friends to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My voice is not as good as theirs; I definitely will not be picked

special_situations.event: Long after submitting the application, still not receiving a reply from the show
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not get a quick response, it means I am not good enough or have been rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated thinking and worrying, avoids discussing this matter with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No news is bad news; I must be no good

special_situations.event: Thinking about one's audition and the judges' evaluation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perform perfectly enough, I will be negated and humiliated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Practices even harder, chooses safer pieces, and seeks feedback cautiously
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will perform very badly; the result will only embarrass me more

special_situations.event: Imagines singing in front of friends and receiving real feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If friends think I am not good, it means objectively I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distances friends, reduces interaction to avoid negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I sing poorly and look down on me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen (hopes one's singing is accepted and affirmed)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected, humiliated, or proven 'not good enough'
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated by staying cautious and self-doubting
Keeps a certain distance from others to avoid being hurt

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough competitor / a self that may be negated
A friend easily negated by others
object_relations.object_representation: Others/friends who may look down on me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When not receiving any reply or feedback from the show for a long time
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting silence as rejection and negation, feeling already judged 'not good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing as if others hold negative views, e.g. 'they must think I am no good', in a cautious tone with self-denial coloring, sharing fewer details

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited or imagining singing in front of friends and collecting feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing friends as harsh judges, anticipating feedback will humiliate her
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-deprecating statements, reducing eye contact, in a lowered tone, proactively lowering self-worth to dodge external evaluation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out his catastrophizing and invites a behavioral experiment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feels scrutinized and required to prove oneself, thus turns to rational discussion to avoid emotional exposure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using theoretical, abstract language, discussing methods and processes, downplaying personal feelings and vulnerability, in a steady, objective tone

manifestations: Relationships with friends tense due to self-doubt
Not discussing her self-doubt with friends and colleagues
Social withdrawal; keeping distance from others when in low mood
outcomes: Increased sense of isolation and feeling misunderstood

manifestations: Self-doubt affecting daily interests and hobbies (e.g. reading)
Decreased drive at work, attention occupied by the audition

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession', often manifesting as 'they are looking down on me'
manifestations: Anticipating others will think she is not good enough
Interpreting the show's silence as negation
Worrying friends will look down on her singing

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and excessive self-restriction, with harsh self-reproach, being overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'
manifestations: Scrutinizing one's performance with harsh standards
Excessive worry and self-denial before performing
Imagining negative consequences before feedback even appears

positive_force: Has basic social support (friends and colleagues to communicate with)
Proactively practices and seeks feedback; willing to take behavioral experiments
Motivated to improve self-doubt and quality of life
Professional discipline and execution (naval personnel background)
negative_force: Cognitive patterns of catastrophizing and over-predicting negative outcomes
Comparing with others and negating the self (comparing and despairing)
Excessively relies on external evaluation, lacks inner self-affirmation
Attention occupied by the audition, impairing work and interests

target_behavior.behavior: Strong self-denial and anxiety when watching <The Voice> or thinking about the audition
antecedent: Thinking about one's audition and being judged
Not yet receiving a reply from the show
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief of 'I am not good enough' and cognitive distortions of catastrophizing and predicting the future are activated
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and humiliation, seeking a brief psychological sense of security
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety and self-doubt, decline in work concentration, low mood

target_behavior.behavior: Distancing from friends due to self-doubt, reduced socializing and interest participation
antecedent: Anticipating singing in front of friends and collecting feedback
Thinking about evaluation when interacting with friends
target_behavior.core_reason: Setting others up as harsh judges and mind reading, worrying about being negated
target_behavior.function: Avoids negative evaluation and embarrassment; reduces the risk of being hurt
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension, increased sense of isolation, decreased enjoyability of life
